units.source_text: 据说，名人从不曾对夫人抱怨过下棋累了、倦了。

en.t: It is said that the Master never once complained to his wife that he was tired or weary from playing go.

units.source_text: 名人一心埋头棋艺，还可以列举一例，这就是夫人常说的一段话，我在奈良屋旅馆时也曾听夫人讲过。

en.t: One more example can be given of how single-mindedly the Master devoted himself to the art of go: it is something his wife often said, and I too heard her speak of it when I was at the Naraya Inn.
